managedVia: Cloudflare dashboard; existing Wrangler OAuth cannot manage WAF

rateLimit.name: R2 图片与收藏接口单 IP 限速
rateLimit.previousName: R2 图片单 IP 限速

customRule.name: 收藏接口非法请求拦截
customRule.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/favorites/events") and ((http.request.method ne "POST") or not any(http.request.headers["origin"][*] eq "https://www.xgif.cn") or not starts_with(lower(http.request.headers["content-type"][0]), "application/json") or (http.request.uri.query ne ""))

rollback: Keep protection during normal frontend rollbacks. To undo this WAF-only change: restore prior rateLimit expression/name and remove only the customRule with the recorded ID. Never overwrite the pre-existing R2 rules.
